evidence.finding: BASE is ACTIVE_BUILD/NOT_PASS; all 14 listed ClayCode work packages are OPEN and no mandatory application proof is recorded as passed.
APP-06 requires a small parser/compiler/interpreter implemented using ClayCode facilities; the contract does not state that the production ClayCode compiler itself must already be self-hosted.
D plus typed-fn locally closes a pure definition/call slice, but strict LALR construction remains negative and CC-WP-02 remains OPEN.
The leading-not-selected D grammar lacks a general function-definition statement and does not yet expose a complete practical compiler-tool programming surface.
Foreign effect closure was already deeply researched; this spawn avoided duplicating it.
Loop lowering already has a local executable discriminator; this spawn avoided duplicating it.
GCC performs a three-stage bootstrap and compares stage2/stage3 compilers.
Rust uses a precompiled stage0 compiler, builds stage1 from current source, builds stage2 with the in-tree compiler, and describes an optional stage3 same-result test.
Compiler bootstrapping and reduction of opaque binary seed dependencies are explicit supply-chain/trust concerns separable from ordinary language semantics.

evidence.source: Reproducible Builds deterministic build systems guidance
evidence.finding: Reproducibility requires deterministic transformation and a defined/recorded build environment; path/time/order variation can invalidate byte identity.

evidence.source: David A. Wheeler, Countering Trusting Trust through Diverse Double-Compiling, ACSAC 2005
evidence.finding: Diverse double-compiling is a separate method for detecting trusting-trust under explicit assumptions; ordinary rebuild identity is not equivalent to DDC.

Same C source compiled by GCC in two different directories produced identical stripped binaries; path-sensitive __FILE__ builds differed; -ffile-prefix-map normalization restored identity; GCC vs Clang binaries differed while 5000 tested semantic cases had 0 output mismatches.

evidence_boundaries: Local hosted Linux execution is not Andreas' Ubuntu developer-system acceptance evidence.
GCC/Rust/Bootstrappable patterns are external analogues, not proof that the same staging is optimal for ClayCode.
0/5000 semantic mismatches is bounded test evidence only, not compiler correctness proof.
Byte-identical rebuilds do not establish source-to-binary semantic correctness by themselves.
Cross-branch project agreement is shared-ancestry evidence unless an independent discriminator is added.
